shared_art_direction: Soft rounded storybook watercolor, smooth gentle earthy washes matching Jungle tiger cover botanicals. Three-quarter downward view. Full object, base bottom center, high resolution. One picture per image, never an atlas.
cutout_constraints: Truly transparent RGBA; no face, eyes, mouth, background, paper patch, ground patch, pot, cast shadow, halo, text or grid. Bed is an opaque full scene.
packaging: Transparent margins are trimmed and cutouts are padded to a square frame with a bottom-centered base; original generated pixels are preserved in backup/garden-redesign/art-originals. Matching 128px RGBA previews load before the full pictures.
